page.layout: One printed page. Running head with page number at top. One text column in the centre, with faint marginal references in the left margin (not legible enough to transcribe reliably). Catchword/signature line at foot: "SECT." at right.

main_text.p: quæ bellum indicit Deo ; vti- nam huiusmodi non esset, quam Roma vel præstare no- bis possit, vel aufit profecto polliceri : Agedum ergo; Pau- linum illud (Greek) sedulo dis- cutiamus ; doceamusque pa- cem coli cum Pontificijs, piam quidem illam & salutarem, non posse; siue auersam partis vtriusque voluntatem, seu litis vtrinque agitatæ naturam, seu denique mediorum quæ ad hanc conciliationem adhiberi debent, impossibilitatem spe- [illegible, ~1 letters]emus ; Tres isti fines mihi e- runt ; quibus opella hæc qua- liscunq; non inutilis certè, nec intempestiua terminabitur.

page.notes: Marginal references in the left margin are faint and only partly legible; the Greek in the text is approximated. The bullet-like mark before "emus" is a printing blot where a letter (probably "Q" or "S") is obscured. Left-margin notes are approximate.
